svg.title: Integral windup: I piles up, then overshoots
svg.desc: Animated, drawn left to right. Top: the dashed target jumps up, a big setpoint change, and the measured position climbs toward it. The error is large for a while; it is shaded purple as I adds it up. Below, the I term climbs far above the line for full output: more than any useful output. When the target is reached all that stored push carries the position past it, shaded red, while the I term unwinds back down. Footer: WPILib's fixes are to reduce kI, ideally to zero, limit the integrator, or use an IZone so I only acts close to the target.
svg.text: Integral windup: I piles up, then overshoots
After a big setpoint change the error is large for a while.
WPILib's fixes: reduce kI (ideally to zero), limit the integrator,
or use an IZone so I only acts close to the target.
